name: Auto Decor
description: Select blocks, press Decor: get an ornate decoration (frames, spires, dotted lines, glow streaks). Endless seeded variations.

style.name: Style
style.description: Overall look. Chaos picks a random base style and adds extras.

detail.name: Detail
detail.description: How many frames, streaks and traces are generated.

thickness.name: Line thickness
thickness.description: Base line thickness in editor units (a block is 30).

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: 0 = new random seed on every press. Any other value always gives the same result. The seed used is shown after each generation.

max-pieces.name: Max objects per generation
max-pieces.description: Safety cap so the editor does not lag.

piece-id.name: Piece object ID
piece-id.description: Every line, dot and triangle is this ONE object, stretched and rotated. Use a NON-solid square (e.g. from the Outline tab). Easiest: select one such object in the editor and press 'Pal'.

no-touch.name: Set 'No Touch' on pieces
no-touch.description: Extra safety for solid piece IDs. Always playtest after generating.

color-accent.name: Accent color channel
color-accent.description: Accent lines and glow (when no fade channels are set).

fade-channels.name: Glow fade channels
fade-channels.description: Comma separated color channel IDs from brightest to dimmest, e.g. 11,12,13,14. Make them the same purple with decreasing opacity. Empty = accent channel only.

fade-steps.name: Glow fade steps
fade-steps.description: How many brightness levels a streak is split into (match the number of fade channels).

editor-layer.name: Editor layer for decor
editor-layer.description: 0 = leave as is. Otherwise generated objects go to this editor layer, so you can hide or lock them.

ui-y.name: Panel Y
ui-y.description: Pixels from the bottom edge (top button).
